summary: Comprehensive testing of NairaTrack after major backend refactoring (2583-line monolith split into modular routes) and 5 new features. Backend API testing achieved 100% success rate (40/40 tests passed). Frontend testing validated all new features: Smart Insights, Recurring Expenses detection, full Pidgin translations, and Browser Push Notifications enable button.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend modular refactoring successful - server.py now ~130 lines vs previous 2583 lines
